contracts.description: The loader supplies an immutable integer batch-mode input before restore-lisp-pointers. Zero means false and a nonzero integer means true, as U1 tests it. The census macro emits a named service dependency; no native NIL-relative kernel-global offset is inherited.

Replace the whole native pointer/C-string path with the loader-supplied bootstrap resource identity in the virtual namespace. This is a string/name contract, not a native executable pointer. Do not mark the containing function optional or unsupported merely because the native mechanism is excluded.
Replace #_exit with a declared Lisp-process termination host service. Preserve status -1 and the nonreturning failure behavior; do not expose arbitrary foreign lookup.

Native executable trailer scanning has no Wasm executable-prefix counterpart. Route image loading through the bundle manifest. Any reachable request for native executable embedding needs a tested Lisp condition; no condition is implemented here.
contracts.native_only_mechanism: Native executable trailer offsets and SEEK_END/SEEK_CUR file descriptor arithmetic

contracts.description: Native executable prefix copying is excluded from the Wasm bundle format. Preserve image saving separately; reject a reachable native/prepend-kernel request through a tested Lisp condition. Do not treat this classification as that implementation.
contracts.native_only_mechanism: Executable-prefix byte copying with native file descriptors and SEEK_SET

contracts.description: Use a capability-gated bundle output in the virtual namespace. Native O_RDONLY/O_WRONLY/O_CREAT, chmod and executable-prefix modes are not host constants for the Wasm profile. Missing write capability requires a tested Lisp condition. Scheduling writable storage later does not discharge this dependency.
contracts.native_only_mechanism: POSIX flags, modes and file descriptors

contracts.description: Restore only the profile-declared runtime/host entry registry; the native FFI/interface database remains excluded. This required startup call cannot be silently deleted or marked unsupported.

Reconstruct validated Wasm/JavaScript callback entries under the declared table/Worker protocol. Native macptr revival and machine-code trampolines need replacement. The native foreign-thread exclusion does not exclude the required Lisp callback dispatcher.
